;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[2019 Western Libya offensive]]
**The [[Libyan National Army]] shoots down a pro-[[Government of National Accord|GNA]] [[Dassault Mirage F1|Mirage F1]] fighter jet over [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], capturing its pilot, who claimed to be [[Portuguese people|Portuguese]], though the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Portugal)|Portuguese Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] couldn't confirm his identity. Pictures released by the LNA's media office show the wounded pilot flanked by LNA officials. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/libya-national-army-pilot-portugal-captured-tripoli-fighter-jet-lna-a8903176.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/05/07/libyan-faction-claims-shot-portuguese-pilot-battle-tripoli/ (''The Telegraph'')]

;Health and environment
*Multiple environmentalists groups file a lawsuit to stop the [[US Forest Service]] from opening up large tracts of the [[Tongass National Forest]] to logging, allegedly without a proper [[Environmental impact assessment#United States|study of the environmental impact]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-alaska-forest-logging/logging-plan-for-alaskas-tongass-national-forest-challenged-in-court-idUSKCN1SE068 (Reuters)] 

;International relations
*[[Iraq–United States relations]]
**[[United States Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]], who originally expected to be in [[Berlin]] today, makes an emergency trip to [[Iraq]] amid escalating tensions with [[Iran]]. Earlier this week, the U.S. deployed a bomber task force and the [[USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72)|USS ''Abraham Lincoln'']] Carrier Strike Group to the region.  In today's meeting with [[Prime Minister of Iraq|Iraqi Prime Minister]] [[Adil Abdul-Mahdi]] and [[President of Iraq|President]] [[Barham Salih]], Pompeo reaffirmed the longstanding U.S. policy to ensure nobody interferes in their country. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48195747 (BBC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/05/politics/iran-carrier-bomber-task-force/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Myanmar]] [[President of Myanmar|President]] [[Win Myint (politician, born 1951)|Win Myint]] pardons two [[Reuters]] journalists, [[Wa Lone]] and [[Kyaw Soe Oo]], who had been imprisoned at [[Insein Prison]] for more than 500 days after being charged with possession of classified documents under the ''Official Secrets Act''. The pair were arrested in December 2017 as they were investigating the [[Inn Din massacre]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-journalists/reuters-reporters-jailed-in-myanmar-freed-from-prison-witnesses-idUSKCN1SD056?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[List of people granted executive clemency in the first presidency of Donald Trump|List of people granted executive clemency by Donald Trump]]
**[[Michael Behenna]], an American soldier convicted of killing an Iraqi prisoner in 2008, is pardoned by [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and invited to dinner. [https://www.npr.org/2019/05/07/720967513/trump-pardons-former-soldier-convicted-of-killing-iraqi-prisoner (NPR)]
*[[2019 STEM School Highlands Ranch shooting]]
**At least one person is killed and eight people are injured in a [[school shooting]] in Douglas County, Colorado. Two suspects are in custody. [https://www.kktv.com/content/news/BREAKING-CO-School-Shooting--509599871.html (KKTV)] [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/at-least-8-students-injured-in-colorado-school-shooting-authorities-say/ar-AAB2wtj?ocid=spartandhp (ABC News via MSN.com)]
*At least seven people are killed and another 20 injured in a shooting at [[Pavón Prison]] near [[Guatemala City]]. The injured have been taken to hospital. Security forces have regained control of the facility. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-48196130 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Danish general election]]
**Danish prime minister [[Lars Løkke Rasmussen]] calls general elections for [[Grundlovsdag]] on 5 June, only a little more than a week after [[2019 European Parliament election in Denmark|Danish elections for the European Parliament]]. [https://www.thelocal.dk/20190507/breaking-danish-pm-calls-general-election-for-june-5th (The Local)]
*[[March 2019 Istanbul mayoral election|2019 Istanbul mayoral election]]
**The [[European Union]] and leading member states such as  Belgium, France and Germany, criticize the [[Turkey|Turkish]] government's decision to re-run [[Istanbul]]'s mayoral election, which was won by underdog [[Ekrem İmamoğlu]] of the opposition multi-party [[Nation Alliance (Turkey)|Nation Alliance]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48190351 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-election-erdogan/turkish-opposition-confident-of-winning-istanbul-poll-re-run-lira-sinks-again-idUSKCN1SD0VI (Reuters)]
